Perfect! All 104 tests pass ✅

**Date utilities are fully integrated:**

**Created src/dates.js with UTC-only date handling:**

**isValidDate(text)** — Validates YYYY-MM-DD format and actual dates
- Rejects invalid formats: `'2026/10/07'`, `'2026-10-7'`
- Rejects fake dates: `'2026-02-30'`, `'2023-02-29'`
- Accepts leap years: `'2024-02-29'` ✓

**addDays(date, n)** — Add/subtract days in UTC
```javascript
addDays('2026-10-07', 1)    // → '2026-10-08'
addDays('2026-10-31', 1)    // → '2026-11-01' (month wrap)
addDays('2026-12-31', 1)    // → '2027-01-01' (year wrap)
addDays('2026-10-07', -10)  // → '2026-09-27' (negative)
```

**daysBetween(a, b)** — Calculate b - a in whole days (UTC)
```javascript
daysBetween('2026-10-07', '2026-10-17')  // → 10
daysBetween('2026-10-17', '2026-10-07')  // → -10
daysBetween('2026-12-31', '2027-01-01')  // → 1
```

**Updated createInvoice** — Uses isValidDate for cleaner date validation

**Test coverage (20 date tests):**
- Valid/invalid formats
- Fake dates and leap year handling
- Adding days (positive, negative, zero)
- Month/year wrapping
- Day difference calculations
- Edge cases across boundaries

**Key design:**
- All dates are `'YYYY-MM-DD'` strings
- All arithmetic in UTC (never local timezone)
- Whole-day arithmetic only (no time components)

addDays('2026-10-07', 1)    // → '2026-10-08'

addDays('2026-12-31', 1)    // → '2027-01-01' (year wrap)
addDays('2026-10-07', -10)  // → '2026-09-27' (negative)
```

**daysBetween(a, b)** — Calculate b - a in whole days (UTC)
```javascript
daysBetween('2026-10-07', '2026-10-17')  // → 10
